title: Principles of Nonviolence (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to practise nonviolence in all interactions, prioritising child safety, emotional stability, and respectful relationships.
learningOutcomes: Understand nonviolence in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise behaviours that create fear or harm.
Learn how to practise nonviolence daily.

modules.title: Nonviolence in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how nonviolence supports children’s safety.

modules.title: Violence Awareness
modules.content: Identifies physical, emotional, and psychological harm.

modules.title: Practising Nonviolence
modules.content: Provides tools for safe, respectful behaviour.
